title: BillingStaffActionPayload
description: billing.staff.action v1 (OpenVibe.Billing server/console/audit.js record). A staff member completed an action in the Billing console (only outcome done is announced; refused actions stay in staff_audit). Holds no secrets: codes, payout reference, counts. Envelope: subject { type: staff_action, id: sa_… }, visibility internal, priority important, actor the staff user ({ type: user, id: usr_… }).

detail.description: Small whitelisted detail of the action.
